Investigation Report
TRACI Case No. 2018-00436		 Investigation Report Page 9 of 13
of Mr. Bose confirms that multiple WhatsApp Chat Groups were created to discuss strategy, opportunities and alliances for KnowledgePodium (Refer Annexure 37 for the WhatsApp Chat Messages recovered). ## Conclusion and Legal Evaluation 30. Based on the material facts established during this investigation as well as testimonial evidence it can be concluded that there are strong indications which point to the fact that Mr. Bose, ex SISW CEO played an active role in a scheme together with mentioned external vendors and their owners with the purpose of misusing public funds. This behaviour, more likely than not, represents a violation of the local laws and the investigation by the Indian authorities is ongoing. SISW is cooperating with the authorities. 31. With regard to Mr. Sharma and Mr. Kurup the facts established during the investigation clearly show that both of them were very close to Mr. Bose and part of his team and assisted Mr. Bose to control and manage external entities with no connection to SISW whatsoever and both of them were aware of the described scheme where money from state funds was misused but they never raised the issue with compliance. With such behaviour they have violated Chapters A.1. (Behaviour which complies with law), H.2. (Conflict of interest) and J. (Working with responsible partners) of the Siemens Business conduct Guidelines, therefore adequate disciplinary sanctions need to be implemented.
